description: Answers your questions about Halkbank's retail, commercial, and SME banking products and services based on the content of the bank's official websites, citing its sources. You can get information in Turkish or English on a wide range of topics, from loans to cards, from Paraf to ParafLy Travel. It cannot access personal data or account information, and cannot perform customer-specific transactions.
